scope.catalog_scope: Concierge fashion inventory: apparel, footwear and fashion accessories. Beauty, home, furniture, jewelry/watches and other non-clothing merchandise are outside this clothing-focused audit except where an item is wearable fashion.

sitemap_inventory.lastmod_observation: Sampled product sitemap records were last modified 2026-10-06 and included Nordstrom-hosted image URLs.
sitemap_inventory.important_scope_note: 526,058 is the complete product-URL count exposed by Nordstrom's product sitemap shards, not a fashion-only item count. Fashion classification still requires reliable product metadata.

completed_actions: Recovered the existing shared ProductMaster architecture and Macy's/SCHEELS inventory methodology without schema changes.
Verified no pre-existing Nordstrom CatalogSource, RetailerOffer or Nordstrom ingestion-run records existed in either Base44 app before this audit.
Confirmed the official Nordstrom robots file and sitemap index are reachable from the Base44 environment.
Enumerated all 53 official Nordstrom product sitemap shards and counted 526,058 current product URLs.
Confirmed direct Base44 retrieval of browse and product pages returns an HTTP 200 browser/anti-bot interstitial rather than dependable product content.
Did not use /api/* or other internal workarounds because Nordstrom's published crawl rules disallow that path family.
Loaded a three-product controlled pilot using current public Nordstrom product evidence and created only one variant where a live size/color/stock combination was explicitly shown.
Did not promote Nordstrom-hosted image URLs into public ProductMaster image fields because attribution does not establish display rights.
Recorded the audit as a partial CatalogIngestionRun in both Base44 apps.

source_findings.robots: Nordstrom publishes a sitemap and permits ordinary public browse/product URLs while disallowing /api/* except explicitly allowed subpaths. No disallowed internal API was used.
source_findings.sitemap_access: The official sitemap is fully reachable from the Base44 environment and provides exhaustive URL enumeration plus last-modified dates and image URLs.
source_findings.product_page_server_access: Direct Base44 requests to public browse and PDP URLs return a browser/anti-bot interstitial that does not expose stable product name, brand, price, structured data or variant fields for bulk parsing.
source_findings.public_rendered_visibility: Current rendered/indexed public Nordstrom pages can expose reliable individual product facts such as brand, product name, price, colors, item number, Core Product ID and sometimes a selected size/availability state.
source_findings.exhaustive_gap: The sitemap itself does not identify fashion department, brand, complete variants, price or availability. Rendered/indexed product pages are useful for controlled validation but are not a stable 526,058-product bulk feed.
source_findings.prohibited_workaround: Internal /api/* paths were not used because published crawl controls disallow them.
source_findings.required_for_full_completion: An authorized Nordstrom/Impact publisher product catalog or feed, an official API/export, or another permitted bulk source that exposes product metadata, variants, current price and availability to the ingestion environment.

data_quality_rule: Do not treat sitemap URL presence as a complete ProductMaster record, and do not create ProductVariant combinations from separate color and size lists unless a source explicitly confirms the combination.
next_operational_dependency: Authorized Nordstrom bulk product source with product/variant/price/availability metadata.
